arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case Selection

You can run specific test cases using one or more `--case` flags.

### Example

```bash
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --binary ./target/release/pilot --repo . --out receipts --provider openai --model gpt-4o --case alpha --case gamma
```

### Selection Rules

- **Original Suite Order**: Selected cases are always executed in their original suite order, regardless of the order in which `--case` flags are provided.
- **Duplicates**: Duplicate `--case` flags (e.g. `--case gamma --case alpha --case gamma`) are ignored; each named case runs at most once.
- **Unknown IDs**: Unknown case IDs fail immediately before creating output directories or executing any cases.
- **No-Filter Default**: Without any `--case` flags, all cases in the suite are run.

arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py.

## Case selection

You can select specific cases to run using the `--case` flag multiple times.

Example:
```
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --case alpha --case gamma
```

This will run only the cases with IDs `alpha` and `gamma` in the original suite order.

- Repeated `--case` flags selecting the same case ID are treated as one selection; duplicates are ignored.
- The cases are always run in the original suite order, regardless of the order of `--case` flags.
- If you do not specify any `--case` flags, all cases run by default.
- If you specify any unknown case IDs, the program will fail immediately with an error before running any cases.

This behavior preserves the original suite order and ensures no duplicate runs of the same case.

arguments.content:
# Coupled pilot

Run the pilot using `scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py`.

## Case selection

By default, all cases in the suite run in their original order.

To select specific cases, use one or more `--case` flags. Repeated flags are deduplicated and the selected cases are executed in the original suite order. Unknown case IDs cause an immediate error and no output or execution occurs.

### Examples

Run all cases (default):
```bash
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --repo /path/to/repo --out /path/to/out
```

Run only alpha and gamma in original suite order:
```bash
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --repo /path/to/repo --out /path/to/out --case alpha --case gamma
```

Run with duplicates (only alpha and gamma will run, in original order):
```bash
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --repo /path/to/repo --out /path/to/out --case alpha --case gamma --case alpha
```

Unknown ID fails before output or execution:
```bash
python3 scripts/run_coupled_pilot.py --repo /path/to/repo --out /path/to/out --case alpha --case missing
# Error: Unknown case ID(s): missing
```

## Receipts and preservation

The tool writes receipts to `--out` and refuses to overwrite existing receipts, preserving independent oracles and preventing accidental overwrites.
